premise: A deeper, less-noisy, a-la-carte coach probe engine. Folds CO4 (adaptive depth), CF6 (endgame sub-types), CF7 (a-la-carte scope), CO7 (radar n/a honesty / game less skippable), CO15 (timed probe).
verdict: PROCEED — every reuse hook verified to exist; no STOP. One hard prerequisite (F3) is DRAFTED-NOT-BUILT and must be honored as a contract.

hooks_verified.evidence: class PuzzleLadder; LadderOpts { min?, max?, themes?, phase?: 'opening'|'middlegame'|'endgame', window? } (lines 45-80). next(now) queries repo.next({rating,window,exclude,themes,phase}). report(solved) calls gradeAttempt but the rating stays LOCAL to the ladder — never persisted to puzzleRating. isDone(): count>=max OR (count>=min AND rd<=90).
hooks_verified.implication: CO4 adaptive depth = vary min/max (and optionally re-arm isDone) per borderline band. AP-COACH-8 already holds (ladder rating is local).

hooks_verified.evidence: next(q: PuzzleQuery) lines 142-169. themes matched via p.themes.includes(t) (ANY-of). phase matched via phaseOf(p.fen) heuristic (NOT a stored field). Deterministic pick via hashId — no Math.random. Returns null when pool empty.
hooks_verified.implication: CF6 endgame sub-types feasible via themes:['rookEndgame'] etc. (theme filter is exact); phase filter is approximate (piece-count heuristic). next() returning null is the graceful fall-through signal.

hooks_verified.evidence: buildCoachProfile({puzzleRating,probes,gameDimensions,assessedAt,locale}) lines 45-105. PURE (no Date/Math.random). n=0 guard drops empty themes (line 56). COACH_MOTIF_PROBES = 6 motifs (line 15); COACH_LADDER_MIN=MAX=2 (lines 21-22). Comment admits +-115 Glicko noise per puzzle.
hooks_verified.implication: Probe-result aggregation already honest (sampleSize labels, no grade). C2 extends the probe SET (endgame buckets, timed) and the ThemeProbeResult inputs; the pure aggregator stays the single sink.

hooks_verified.evidence: Pure state machine: initClock/startClock/stopClock/tick(elapsedMs)/press/flagged. NO Date.now / performance.now inside — UI feeds elapsed ms (lines 1-62).
hooks_verified.implication: CO15 timed probe reuses Clock for the time budget; UI owns performance.now() deltas. Pure-core testable.

hooks_verified.evidence: Unmeasured axes (sampleSize===0) collapse to centre (0.02) and render an 'n/a' tspan (lines 24-54). audit v2 L17 / PR #21.
hooks_verified.implication: CO7 'radar n/a honesty' ALREADY shipped at the radar level. The real CO7 gap is upstream: the optional game is skippable so 4 dims stay n/a. C2 addresses make-the-game-less-skippable, NOT the radar render.

hooks_verified.evidence: THEMES array (lines 23-26) = 6 motifs + {theme:'endgame', phase:'endgame'}. startThemeLadder builds one PuzzleLadder per THEMES entry (lines 63-74); endgame uses phase:'endgame', themes:undefined => one coarse bucket. onLadderMove reports solved/wrong (lines 87-103). Probe order fixed; all-or-nothing (no scope picker).
hooks_verified.implication: CF6 = expand the endgame THEMES entry into 2-3 themed entries. CF7 = make THEMES subsettable from a user selection. CO4 = per-entry adaptive min/max. CO15 = add a timed entry. The driver is the single edit surface.

hooks_verified.evidence: recordTacticsAttempt({attempt,puzzle,model,srs,now}) lines 37-58 — ONE atomic tx over puzzleAttempts+puzzles+srsCards+playerModel. resultToGrade(solved,ms) in src/srs/fsrs.ts:28.
hooks_verified.implication: Q-E: if C2 records probe attempts it consumes THIS path (per F3) with puzzle+model rating fields UNCHANGED and coachProbe:true — never gradeAttempt, never pool mutation.

F3_attempt-recording-weakness.evidence: grep 'coachProbe' over src/ returns ZERO matches; the additive PuzzleAttemptRecord.coachProbe? field and the Coach.svelte recording wire-up are not merged.
F3_attempt-recording-weakness.consequence: C2 ◄ F3 (architecture DAG, Phase 2). C2's probe-recording sub-feature is a HARD prerequisite on F3. Either build F3 first, or (if C2 lands first) C2 introduces coachProbe? itself and F3 inherits it. Default: treat F3 as the contract; C2 records THROUGH it.

no_stop_rationale: All five fold targets (CO4/CF6/CF7/CO7/CO15) map to verified hooks. The only premise risk — CF6 endgame sub-type themes not existing — is resolved: the ETL preserves raw Lichess themes verbatim, which DO include rookEndgame/pawnEndgame/etc. The seed fallback lacks them, handled by graceful fall-back + honest reporting (AP-COACH-6).
